stories.title: Juve a valanga in Europa, 5-0 al Nec. Primi gol per Alajbegovic e Woltemade, si sblocca Kolo Muani

en.title: Juve crushes in Europe, 5-0 against NEC. First goals for Alajbegovic and Woltemade, Kolo Muani breaks the ice
en.summary: Juventus defeated Dutch side NEC 5-0 in their Europa League opener. Nico Gonzalez and Celik also scored in the convincing victory.

stories.title: Preso il killer più sanguinario del Brasile, ha confessato 80 omicidi

en.title: Brazil's most brutal killer arrested, confesses to 80 murders
en.summary: Jorlan Alves da Silva, age 33, was captured after committing his first killing at age 13 while working as a hitman for a local criminal organization.

stories.title: Navi italiane nel Mar Rosso, la sfida di Crosetto all'Ue: “Difendiamo solo i nostri cargo”

en.title: Italian ships in the Red Sea, Crosetto's challenge to the EU: "We defend only our cargo"
en.summary: Italian Defense Minister Crosetto is challenging the EU position on Red Sea operations while exploring potential coordination with France and Greece on the matter.

stories.title: Jet militari russi violano lo spazio aereo lituano, caccia italiani in volo. Prime sanzioni Usa contro Mosca

en.title: Russian military jets violate Lithuanian airspace, Italian fighter jets in flight. First US sanctions against Moscow
en.summary: The US House voted to impose initial sanctions on Russia ahead of elections, dealing a setback to Putin. Trump is scheduled to meet Zelensky next week at the UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Bonelli, incomprensibile mano tesa Schlein a Meloni su energia, serve alternativa

en.title: Bonelli, incomprehensible extended hand from Schlein to Meloni on energy, an alternative is needed
en.summary: A politician criticizes what he views as an inexplicable gesture of cooperation from Schlein toward Meloni regarding energy policy, arguing that opposition to a government harming Italy is necessary instead.

stories.title: Meloni dopo la lettera di Schlein: "Non ho pregiudizi, approfondirò". Conte e Bonelli: “Non ci sono le condizioni per collaborare”

en.title: Meloni after Schlein's letter: "I have no prejudices, I will look into it". Conte and Bonelli: "There are no conditions for collaboration"
en.summary: The prime minister expressed openness to examining a proposal from Schlein following a meeting with Norway's prime minister, while opposition leaders stated that conditions do not exist for working with the government.

stories.title: Il ministro Crosetto: "Ripristinare traffico navi italiane attraverso lo stretto di Bab el-Mandeb"

en.title: Defense Minister Crosetto: "Restore Italian ship traffic through the Strait of Bab el-Mandeb"
en.summary: The defense minister announced plans to resume Italian maritime circulation through the Strait of Bab el-Mandeb, comparing the significance of this move to reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Mattarella: “Violenza sulle donne emergenza di primaria importanza”

en.title: Mattarella: "Violence against women a primary importance emergency"
en.summary: The head of state visited a dedicated facility at a hospital emergency department, emphasizing that violence against women represents a critical emergency requiring attention.

stories.title: Meloni cancella il bollo per milioni di auto: cosa c’è dietro la scelta del governo

en.title: Meloni cancels vehicle tax for millions of cars: what is behind the government's choice
en.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced the abolition of vehicle tax for certain vehicles for one year. The move reflects the government's navigation of public finance constraints and political considerations ahead of upcoming elections.

stories.title: Piove negli Uffizi, bagnata la teca del Bacco di Caravaggio

en.title: It rains in the Uffizi, the case of Caravaggio's Bacchus gets wet
en.summary: A water leak occurred in the Uffizi Gallery during a rainstorm, damaging the display case containing Caravaggio's Bacchus painting.

stories.title: Bollo auto, regole e limiti: cosa c’è da sapere sullo stop in vigore nel 2027

en.title: Vehicle tax, rules and limits: what you need to know about the suspension in effect in 2027
en.summary: The article explains the regulations and restrictions regarding the vehicle tax suspension that will take effect in 2027, including rules for multiple vehicle owners.

stories.title: Il bollo auto di Meloni: la vignetta di Ellekappa

en.title: Meloni's vehicle tax: the cartoon by Ellekappa
en.summary: A political cartoon by Ellekappa comments on the vehicle tax policy announced by the Meloni government.

stories.title: Agevolazioni, un tesoretto di 46 miliardi sprecati

en.title: Tax breaks, 46 billion in wasted resources
en.summary: PwC analysis suggests unused tax incentives could unlock resources for business growth and hiring. An AI recovery tool identified average savings exceeding 1,500 euros per employee for companies.

stories.title: Economia del mare, occupati a 1,1 milioni e crescita prevista del 7,1%

en.title: Maritime economy, 1.1 million employed and projected growth of 7.1%
en.summary: The maritime economy sector employed 1.1 million people with expected 7.1% growth. Added value from the sector increased over 22% between 2022 and 2024, approaching 79 billion.

stories.title: Ai, raddoppiano le imprese italiane che ne fanno uso

en.title: AI, Italian companies using it double
en.summary: The number of Italian companies adopting artificial intelligence has doubled in the past year, reaching nearly one in five firms at 19.5%. Data comes from recent Unioncamere-Dintec survey findings.

en.title: Caddy's (Dmo) enters Gruppo VéGé
en.summary: Caddy's, a retail chain specializing in personal care, beauty, hygiene, and household products currently owned by Dmo, will join the VéGé system starting January 1, 2027.

stories.title: Gestione stress, lavoro di squadra e comunicazione, l’eredità dei 20mila volontari di Milano Cortina

en.title: Stress management, teamwork and communication, the legacy of Milan Cortina's 20,000 volunteers
en.summary: Randstad's assessment highlights that volunteers from the Milan Cortina Olympics acquired highly sought-after skills that young people can leverage in the job market.
